description: Smart Parking Lots is a dataset listed in ACT Government open data portal (www.data.act.gov.au), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by ACT Government. SmartParking is a trial designed to help ease traffic congestion and lower travel times by using real-time bay sensor data and the ParkCBR app to show drivers where they are more likely to find available car parking in the Manuka shopping precinct. Coverage: Australian Capital Territory. The portal files it under the category Transport. Its tags are trial, parking. The table has 20 columns. Attribution on the portal: ACT Government. The portal shows 2017-07-28 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-act-gov-au-portal.
